    opts              = opts or {}
    local copies      = opts.copies_per_point or 1
    local buffKV      = opts.buff
    local maxAlive    = opts.max_alive
    local buffBuilder = opts.buff_builder
    local run_id      = opts.run_id

    if not monsters or not next(monsters) then return end
    if not points or #points == 0 then return end

    local buff             = self:ParseBuffKV(buffKV)
    local diffBuff         = self:GetDifficultyBuff()

    local fixedBuffs       = {}
    local fixedBuffIDs     = {}

    local diffBuffID       = diffBuff.tag
    fixedBuffs[diffBuffID] = diffBuff.buff
    table.insert(fixedBuffIDs, diffBuffID)

    for template, countStr in pairs(monsters) do
        --print("Spawning monster group:", template)

        local count = tonumber(countStr) or 0

        if count > 0 then
            if buffKV then
                local buffID       = opts.tag .. "_" .. template
                fixedBuffs[buffID] = buff
                table.insert(fixedBuffIDs, buffID)

                -- print("------[Buff]------")
                -- print("ID", buffID)
                -- DeepPrintTable(buff)
                -- print("------[Buff]-------")
            end


            local base_buff_kv = MonsterStatsKV[template]

                print("[spawn_manager] SpawnGroup: no MonsterStatsKV for template =", template)
                return
            end

            local unit_name = base_buff_kv.UnitName
            local base_buff = self:ParseBuffKV(base_buff_kv or {})
            local baseBuffID = "base_" .. template
            fixedBuffs[baseBuffID] = base_buff
            table.insert(fixedBuffIDs, baseBuffID)

            -- print("------[BaseBuff]------")
            -- print("ID", baseBuffID)

            local allBuffDataList = {}

                    if next(extraBuff) then
                        local dynamicBuffID = opts.tag .. "_" .. template
                        fixedBuffs[dynamicBuffID] = extraBuff
                        table.insert(allBuffIDs, dynamicBuffID)

                        -- print("------[ExtraBuff]------")
                        -- print("ID", dynamicBuffID)

                        end

                                end

                        end

                        local mod_ai = monster_system:ApplyStat(unit)

                        local show_health_panel = is_boss_unit

    if len <= 0.0001 then

    local ang = math.deg(math.acos(dot))
    if ang <= limit_deg then

    end
    local cross = g.x * d.y - g.y * d.x

        end,
    })

    if not wall or wall:IsNull() then

    end

        good = {},
        bad = {},
        good_keys = {},
        bad_keys = {},
    }

    for i = 1, 7, 1 do

        local bad_name = "monster_spawn_point_" .. i
        local good_point = Entities:FindByName(nil, good_name)
        local bad_point = Entities:FindByName(nil, bad_name)
        if good_point then

            points.good[idx] = good_point:GetAbsOrigin()
            table.insert(points.good_keys, idx)
